gcp_pci_bucket_0742bd5dc32c.summary: Add a supported lifecycle rule to the flagged versioned Cloud Storage bucket.
steps: Inspect versioning.enabled and lifecycle.rule on the exact bucket and inventory current/noncurrent object retention requirements.
Choose a supported action and condition with the data owner, stage a reviewed full lifecycle policy and test its effect on representative object versions.
Read back the lifecycle rule, verify retention behavior, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Lifecycle actions may delete objects or change storage class, and can increase retrieval cost; review legal holds and retention policies before applying.
This predicate tests rule presence and syntax, not whether its condition enforces the intended business retention period.

gcp_pci_bucket_3d76b0b0701e.summary: Set an approved positive retention period on the flagged versioned bucket.
steps: Inspect versioning.enabled and retentionPolicy.retentionPeriod for this exact bucket and identify data preservation obligations.
Choose a positive duration with the data/legal owner, test restore and deletion behavior, then apply the reviewed bucket retention policy.
Read back the retention period, confirm intended objects remain recoverable, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: A retention policy prevents early deletion and can materially increase storage cost; locking the policy is a distinct irreversible action and is not requested here.
A positive period passes this predicate without proving that the duration meets an organization's retention requirement.

gcp_pci_instance_template_2e26bed500fc.summary: Replace the flagged instance template's external access configuration.
steps: Inspect properties.networkInterfaces[].accessConfigs[] on the exact template and identify managed instance groups or deployments that consume it.
Create a reviewed replacement template without the external access configuration and test private management, egress and deployment paths before migrating consumers.
Verify the replacement template and resulting instances, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Instance templates are immutable; replacing one can require managed instance group updates and may change client reachability.
The template predicate does not prove a running VM is currently publicly reachable or that every consumer has migrated.

gcp_pubsub_topic_cmek.summary: Use an approved customer-managed key for this Pub/Sub topic.
steps: Inspect the exact topic's kmsKeyName and the project/location of an approved Cloud KMS key.
Review key location, Pub/Sub service-agent permissions and rotation continuity, then configure the topic to use the approved key.
Publish and consume a test message through the intended path, read back kmsKeyName, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Missing KMS permissions or a disabled key can halt publish/consume operations; verify service-agent access before changing encryption.
Changing a topic key does not re-encrypt messages already published with the prior key.

gcp_pci_bigquery_dataset_6017267cdf32.summary: Remove public READER or WRITER grants from this BigQuery dataset.
steps: Inspect the complete FULL-view dataset access[] entries and identify READER or WRITER grants to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.
Have the data owner approve replacement named principals or groups, then update the reviewed complete dataset ACL without dropping required project or authorized-view entries.
Test intended queries and denied public access, read back the FULL ACL, recollect and rerun this exact check.
caveats: Changing a dataset ACL can interrupt queries, authorized views and scheduled jobs; preserve all unrelated entries.
This predicate does not evaluate OWNER grants or effective access inherited from project/folder policies; the separate allUsers predicate has a different scope.

field_binding.path: _provenance.representation=full; access[].role in READER/WRITER; specialGroup or iamMember in allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers

gcp_pci_bigquery_dataset_fb9fcc01d5b7.summary: Remove allUsers grants from this BigQuery dataset ACL.
steps: Inspect the complete FULL-view dataset access[] entries for allUsers in specialGroup or iamMember at any role.
Review each flagged grant with the data owner and replace it with approved named principals or groups in the complete ACL declaration.
Validate required clients and denied public access, read back the FULL ACL, recollect and rerun this exact check.
caveats: Revoking allUsers access can interrupt clients; stage replacement grants and test authorization before cutover.
This signed predicate does not flag allAuthenticatedUsers; other public-access checks may have a broader scope.
